items.title: Show HN: DBOS Java – Postgres-Backed Durable Workflows

As your workflows run, it checkpoints each step they take in a Postgres database. When a process stops (fails, restarts, or crashes), your program can recover from those checkpoints to restore its exact state and continue from where it left off, as if nothing happened.
